text: {"lessons":["One month’s price move is not enough evidence to trade; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Selling Stock A after a gain and buying it back later at a lower price did not guarantee a better outcome; I should make trades according to a consistent plan, not recent gains alone.","I should preserve cash and consider how each purchase affects my overall concentration and risk, while keeping my ten-year apartment goal in view."]}
